messages:
jess: OK folks — PR #4827 ready for review: onprem installer migration guide (v1 -> v2) + compact networking examples for Private/VPC deployments. I added notes about SNAT vs MASQUERADE and an offline bundle checklist. preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4827 :eyes:
sam: Quick skim — found a link pointing to the old KMS rotation doc under the "rotation" section. Should point to /docs/private/kms/rotation-v2 instead. I can batch-fix if we want a single commit.
maria: I can take the link fixes. Also adding a tiny systemd ordering example so the HSM token directory is mounted before the installer runs:```
[Unit]
Description=Mount HSM volume
Requires=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
Before=redwood-installer.service
```
jonathan: We need a clear PKCS#11 example for SoftHSM integration. Minimal config I tested locally:```bash
# /etc/softhsm2.conf
directories.tokendir = /var/lib/softhsm/tokens
# create token
softhsm2-util --init-token --free --label test-token --pin 1234
```
And in the installer YAML:```yaml
hsm:
  provider: pkcs11
  slot: 0
  pin: "1234"
  module_path: /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
```
sam: Also call out file permissions: `/var/lib/softhsm/tokens` must be `0700` and owned by the service account the installer uses. Add an explicit preflight check for that.
jess: Good catch. @maria can you add a short preflight checklist section: network (DNS, MTU note), required outbound ports for private deployments, and the KMS health command? Keep it 6 bullets max.
maria: Done — added bullets and `redwoodctl health --target kms` snippet plus a note that key rotation webhooks require egress to the KMS endpoint on 443 or a private peering route. Also clarified NAT behavior for SNAT vs MASQUERADE in AWS vs on-prem routers.
docs-bot: heads-up — broken link detector flagged `/docs/private/kms/old-rotation` and `/docs/airgap/old-bundle` — both updated in the branch.
preview-bot: docs preview deployed for PR #4827 — https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4827 (check the HSM section + systemd snippet)
jess: Can someone from eng-qa smoke-test the installer in an air-gapped VM? Main things to validate: token creation, installer preflight passes, installer can apply network policy rules (iptables/nft) without hanging.
sam: I'll run a smoke test tonight on a minimal VM image and post logs. If I hit a blocker I'll open an issue. :thumbsup:
jonathan: FYI opened follow-up PR #4830 for PKCS#11 perms and an automated test that creates a token during CI.
jess: Great — aiming to merge by EOD tomorrow once QA signs off. Thanks all! :tada:
